text:
Maya Chen: Heads-up team — planning a 48h holiday micro-burst to push MQLs via search + retargeting. Goal: +20% MQLs with flat CPA. Need creative refresh, tight pacing, and quick QA. Any immediate concerns?

Alex Rivera: Sounds good. Proposed config: A/B creative (Discount vs Value), three geo buckets (US/CA/UK), PST dayparting 9am-9pm. Canary first 2h at 25%. What's the CPA ceiling?

Priya Singh: Lock CPA target at $45 for webinar signups. Retarget windows: 1d high-intent, 7d warm, 14d broad. Short lookbacks for max lift. I'll prepare segments. Landing variant B needed asap.

Nate O'Connor: Landing B is deployed (short hero, 1-step form). Wiring GA events now. Suggest soft max CPC on top keywords to stop spend spikes. UTM template: utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=holiday_microburst_2023&utm_term={keyword}&utm_content={creative_variant} — ensure Looker joins match.

ads-bot: Account summary -> daily_cap:$8500, spare_today:$3200. Recommend ramp: 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 6h; auto-rollback if CPA > $60 for 30m. Canary channel created.

Maya Chen: Proposed launch 2023-12-15 00:00 PST, run 48h. Canary on top 3 keyword groups for first 2h then open. Assign owners?

Priya Singh: I'll own audience lists + retarget windows. Will export segments to #ads-ops by 11:00 PT. 1d high-intent list will exclude conversions in last 24h.

Alex Rivera: I'll own creative and copy. Drafts up in #ads-creative. Creative A = Discount, Creative B = Time-limited value. Need sign-off by 10:30 to hit the schedule.

Nate O'Connor: On GA events and landing QA. Use event name microburst_signup exactly (Looker expects it). Adding a 200ms delay on redirect to ensure event collects. Also confirm GCLID passthrough for attribution.

Priya Singh: Canary rules: top 3 keyword groups at 25% for 2h. Metrics to watch: CTR, conv rate, CPA. If conv rate +30% vs baseline and CPA <= $45, ramp to 50%.

Alex Rivera: Small test idea — alternate CTA in UK geo: "Save your seat" vs "Register now" on creative B. Can we try?

Maya Chen: Good idea. Alex owns UK variant. Priya, make sure audience geo filters are clean. Nate, timezone routing check on the landing.

ads-bot: Staging campaign created id=987654321, canary live at 25%. Monitoring alerts set for CPA and spend velocity. Will post 15m cadence metrics to the thread.

Nate O'Connor: No infra blockers. One ask: confirm GCLID -> microburst_signup mapping in GA to avoid attribution skew.

Priya Singh: Confirmed GCLID passthrough. Exported audience CSV to #ads-ops.

Alex Rivera: Creatives posted to #ads-creative — need final sign-off by 10:30.

Maya Chen: Tagged owners @Alex Rivera @Priya Singh @Nate O'Connor. Sync 20m before launch for final checks. Debrief 48h after burst and pull microburst_lift_v1 in Looker. Any blockers?

Alex Rivera: None.

Priya Singh: None.

Nate O'Connor: None.

ads-bot: Reminder scheduled 30m before launch. Live metrics every 15m in thread.

Maya Chen: Thanks team — keep CPA stable and maximize qualified signups.
